float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: The estimator registers in f32 against GNU Radio's doubles, then the same formulas in f64: M2M4 and SVR subtract nearly equal terms (noise = y1 - sqrt(2 y1^2 - y2)), which amplifies the 1e-7 relative f32 error by the signal to noise ratio (100 at 20 dB): measured 0.0006 dB at 20 dB, below 1e-4 dB at 12 dB.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Registers with 40 fractional bits (simple: y2 at 32), |z|^2 rounded to 28; measured below 1e-4 dB from the float instance, 6e-4 at 20 dB where M2M4 amplifies by the SNR.
As q15, 17 bit samples are exact in the same registers.
